# Independent ODT related-text fixtures

`baseline.fodt` and `changed.fodt` are authored Flat ODF sources, converted into real ODT packages by LibreOfficeDev 26.8.0.0.alpha0, build `2c87e51eeaa2b413ff4ae097b2705eea1995d8e5`, on 2026-10-23. No application extractor or writer produces these packages. The main body is identical; the first header/footer and footnote/endnote change from `original` to `changed`.

`ReadRelated.java` loads the sources through UNO with the named `MacroExecMode.NEVER_EXECUTE` and `UpdateDocMode.NO_UPDATE` constants, writes new files with the `writer8` filter, closes them, then independently reloads each ODT using those same restrictions. The loader is hidden and read-only. No external targets exist in the sources, and no external resources or updates are requested. The captured `libreoffice-readback.txt` reports text, notes, page-style usage, and actual paragraph page-style assignments.

The first paragraph uses `InheritedStart`, whose named parent style `Start` specifies master page `First`. LibreOffice preserves that inheritance in the package and resolves the actual page style to First. The second paragraph explicitly starts Second; the final paragraph inherits the currently active page style. The package also retains an unused master page with sentinel header/footer text. LibreOffice confirms `Unused` is not in use. It adds an Endnote page style with no header/footer, which is in use for the endnote. These are document semantics independently verified by the office suite, not assumptions from the extractor.

`expected.json` records authored visible-story text and the independently observed page-style assignments. Its `main` value intentionally excludes note citations/bodies, matching the established body-only policy; the UNO BODY record includes citation labels. Logical related-text markers are application-defined and do not claim page rendering, exact pagination, or source whitespace fidelity.

Reproduction requires the bundled `soffice`, a JDK, and the official LibreOffice Java UNO library (qualification used `org.libreoffice:libreoffice:24.2.7`). Compile `ReadRelated.java`, start a fresh isolated LibreOffice profile with `--headless --norestore --nodefault --nofirststartwizard --accept=socket,host=127.0.0.1,port=20423;urp;StarOffice.ServiceManager`, then invoke the class with absolute paths to both `.fodt` sources. It terminates its own desktop after readback. ZIP timestamps may change upon regeneration. `sha256.json` pins the committed fixtures and authored sources.
